overview_description.description: Skyways designs and manufactures long-range autonomous unmanned cargo aircraft systems for logistics and operational efficiency. It offers drone hardware, software, and AI technology that enable autonomous operations to allow defense, maritime, oil and gas, and manufacturing industries to achieve scalable, integrated aerial solutions. The company provides two UAV models: the operational V2 (max range ≈ 450 miles, payload ~30 lb) and the upcoming V3 (range 1,000+ miles, payload ~100 lb). The company serves sectors like oil & gas, military, defense, and emergency response, delivering life‑saving supplies, offshore resupply, and critical components via VTOL unmanned systems.
